title: assign_number uses two round-trips per article under write lock
description: O(1) but HIGH CONTENTION — assign_number (article_numbers.rs:46) opens a write transaction then executes SELECT … MAX + INSERT as two separate queries. SQLite serialises all writers, so at ingest rates >~100 msg/s this becomes the primary bottleneck. Fix: replace with INSERT OR IGNORE … RETURNING or a single INSERT … SELECT MAX+1 … WHERE NOT EXISTS to eliminate the explicit SELECT round-trip inside the transaction.
